Statistics Tutorial Santiago Rojas Welcome Welcome to my Statistics tutorial. This tutorial includes foundations, probability, and regression.
1 Foundations This chapter introduces the foundations of statistics. 1.1 What is statistics? Statistics is a set of methods for organizing, describing, analyzing, and interpreting data.

3 Regression This chapter introduces regression. 3.1 What is regression? Regression is a method for modeling relations between variables.
